name: DIY plywood shelving
description: Self-built open shelving from 18 mm plywood: side panels + inner uprights (bays), evenly spaced shelves, 4 mm hardboard back for rigidity. Freestanding, wood-to-wood screws only. Keep bays ≤ ~80 cm so 18 mm shelves don't sag.

source.notes: Sheet sizes in Israel: 122 x 244 cm (plywood 18 mm, hardboard/MDF 3-4 mm).
